item.description: “The next owner will have an opportunity not just to redevelop a building, but to act as a steward of that history and shape what it becomes for the next generation. That’s a rare position to be in.”

item.title: Mechanicsville's Parkhaus Auto Storage opens second location in Ashland - Richmond BizSense
item.description: “What I’ve found is it’s a wide net of people. It’s not just the enthusiast types ... I haven’t found that it’s all Ferraris and Lamborghinis,” David Byrd said of his auto storage business.

item.description: The project from Maryland-based Lion Gate Ventures is adjacent to the mixed-use Cosby Village Square, parts of which are still under construction, and is also close to the proposed 200-acre mixed-use Nunnally Village project.

item.title: Talbots store closes at Short Pump Town Center - Richmond BizSense
item.description: The move leaves the women's clothing retailer with three stores remaining in the Richmond region: two in River Road Shopping Center and one at Stony Point Fashion Park.
